focus.title: 欧盟正式通过《外国补贴条例》实施细则，中企投标与并购面临更严审查
focus.summary: 欧盟理事会于2026年6月29日正式通过《外国补贴条例》实施细则，明确要求非欧盟企业在参与欧盟公共采购或大型并购时，须主动申报过去三年内获得的外国财政资助，否则将面临最高10%年营业额的罚款。该细则将于2026年9月1日生效，覆盖金额超过5亿欧元的交易。中国企业需提前梳理内部补贴台账，评估合规风险。
focus.title_en: EU Adopts Implementing Rules for Foreign Subsidies Regulation: Tighter Scrutiny for Chinese Bidders and Acquirers
focus.summary_en: On June 29, 2026, the Council of the EU formally adopted implementing rules for the Foreign Subsidies Regulation, requiring non-EU companies to proactively declare any foreign financial contributions received in the past three years when participating in large public procurement or M&A deals. Non-compliance may result in fines up to 10% of annual turnover. The rules take effect on September 1, 2026, covering transactions exceeding €500 million. Chinese enterprises should audit subsidy records and assess compliance risks in advance.
focus.source_en: Source: Official Journal of the EU · 2026.06.29

case.title: 英国高等法院裁定：跨境特许权协议中“最惠国”条款不自动适用新法规优惠
case.summary: 2026年6月，英国高等法院对一起中英企业间的特许权使用费纠纷作出判决，认定特许权协议中的“最惠国”（MFN）条款仅适用于签约时已存在的法规优惠，不涵盖后续新出台的税收或监管减免。法院强调，除非协议明确约定“动态最惠国”，否则被许可方不得援引MFN条款主张适用后续更优惠的法规。此案提醒中国企业在谈判跨境IP协议时，应明确MFN条款的适用范围和时间节点。
case.source: 来源：英国高等法院判例 · 2026.06
case.title_en: UK High Court Rules: MFN Clause in Cross-Border Licensing Agreement Does Not Automatically Extend to New Regulatory Benefits
case.summary_en: In June 2026, the UK High Court ruled in a royalty dispute between a Chinese and a UK company that a 'most-favored-nation' (MFN) clause in a licensing agreement applies only to regulatory benefits existing at the time of signing, not to subsequent tax or regulatory relief. The court emphasized that unless the agreement explicitly provides for a 'dynamic MFN,' the licensee cannot claim later-enacted favorable rules. This case reminds Chinese enterprises to clearly define the scope and timing of MFN clauses when negotiating cross-border IP agreements.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区试点“跨境数据流动白名单”机制，首批企业数据出境简化审批
policy.summary: 广东省网信办于2026年6月28日发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动便利化试点方案》，对纳入“白名单”的企业，其向港澳地区传输非敏感个人数据及重要数据以外的商业数据，可免于安全评估，仅需备案。首批名单涵盖金融、医疗、跨境电商等领域的30家企业。此举旨在降低合规成本，促进大湾区数据要素流动。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.06.28
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Pilots 'White List' for Cross-Border Data Flows: Simplified Approval for First Batch of Enterprises
policy.summary_en: On June 28, 2026, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province released the 'Pilot Plan for Facilitating Cross-Border Data Flows in the Greater Bay Area,' under which enterprises on the 'white list' may transfer non-sensitive personal data and commercial data (excluding important data) to Hong Kong and Macao without a security assessment, requiring only filing. The first batch covers 30 enterprises in finance, healthcare, cross-border e-commerce, etc. This move aims to reduce compliance costs and promote data flow in the GBA.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · 2026.06.28

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟《外国补贴条例》下，中企应建立内部补贴台账与交易前筛查机制
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：随着欧盟《外国补贴条例》实施细则即将生效，中国企业参与欧盟公共采购或并购前，必须建立全面的内部补贴台账，覆盖过去三年内获得的各类财政资助（包括税收减免、低息贷款、政府注资等）。建议在交易初期即进行补贴合规筛查，评估申报义务；必要时可聘请欧盟本地律师进行模拟申报。此外，协议中应明确约定补贴申报责任的分配与赔偿条款，以防范交易风险。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Under EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation, Chinese Enterprises Should Establish Internal Subsidy Ledgers and Pre-Transaction Screening Mechanisms
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: With the implementing rules of the EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation soon to take effect, Chinese enterprises participating in EU public procurement or M&A must establish comprehensive internal subsidy ledgers covering all financial contributions received in the past three years (including tax breaks, low-interest loans, government capital injections, etc.). It is advisable to conduct subsidy compliance screening at the early stage of a transaction to assess filing obligations; engaging EU local counsel for mock filings may be necessary. Moreover, contracts should clearly allocate subsidy filing responsibilities and include indemnification clauses to mitigate transactional risks.
